description: Chabad.org's zmanim, Shabbat and holiday times, and daily Chitas in your terminal, plus a today dashboard, next-zman countdown, and weekly bulletin.

tools.name: candles_weeks
tools.description: Upcoming Shabbat and holiday groups with candle-lighting, 'light from a pre-existing flame' second-night times, Shabbat/holiday end times, Hebrew dates, and Torah readings. Optional: location-id (default: 11213), location-type (default: 2), from (plus 2 more). Returns array of CandleGroup.

params.name: location-id
params.description: Chabad.org location ID: a city ID (location-type 1) or a 5-digit US ZIP code (location-type 2). Defaults to 11213 (Crown Heights, Brooklyn), so 'sync' has a location to store.

params.name: location-type
params.description: 1 = Chabad.org city ID, 2 = US ZIP code (default 2, matching the default ZIP)

params.name: from
params.description: Start searching for Shabbat/holidays from this day, YYYY-MM-DD (default: today)

params.name: weeks
params.description: Number of Shabbat weeks to return; holiday groups inside the window are added on top (this is a count, not pagination)

params.name: candle-minutes
params.description: Light candles this many minutes before sunset instead of the location's Chabad.org default

tools.name: locations_search
tools.description: Search Chabad.org locations by city name or US ZIP code. Value is the location ID; ItemType 1 = Chabad.org city ID, 2 = US ZIP code. Required: query. Returns array of LocationSuggestion.

params.name: query
params.description: City name or US ZIP code to look up (e.g. 'Los Angeles', 'Jerusalem', '11213')

tools.name: zmanim_days
tools.description: Per-day zmanim (dawn through midnight), candle-lighting and Shabbat-end times, Torah reading, and holiday name for a location over a date range (up to ~180 days per call). Required: location-id, location-type. Optional: from, to, all-opinions (plus 4 more). Returns array of ZmanimDay.

params.name: location-id
params.description: Chabad.org location ID: a city ID (location-type 1) or a 5-digit US ZIP code (location-type 2). Find one with 'locations search'.

params.name: location-type
params.description: 1 = Chabad.org city ID, 2 = US ZIP code, 3 = custom coordinates (use --coords and --tz)

params.name: to
params.description: Last day, YYYY-MM-DD (default: same as --from; ranges longer than ~180 days are truncated by Chabad.org)

params.name: all-opinions
params.description: Return every halachic opinion for each zman instead of the Chabad default

params.name: tz
params.description: Time zone for custom coordinates, Chabad.org format: IANA name with '/' written as '*' (e.g. America*New_York, Asia*Jerusalem)

params.name: candle-minutes
params.description: Light candles this many minutes before sunset instead of the location's Chabad.org default (18 in most places, 40 in Jerusalem)

novel_features.name: Today dashboard
novel_features.description: One screen with the Hebrew date, parsha, holiday, today's zmanim with the next one highlighted, the Omer count, and today's Chitas and Rambam.

novel_features.name: Next zman countdown
novel_features.description: The next halachic times and how many minutes until each, rolling into tomorrow's dawn, with an exit-code mode for automation.

novel_features.name: Weekly bulletin block
novel_features.description: A copy-paste weekly block for newsletters and shul signage (--format md|plain, --days N): Shabbat times with week-over-week change, parsha, Hebrew date, Mevarchim and Rosh Chodesh notices, and upcoming holidays, for one or more locations.

novel_features.name: Holiday-season lookahead
novel_features.description: Every fast, erev Yom Tov, Yom Tov end, Rosh Chodesh, Shabbat Mevarchim and first Chanukah candle in the next N days, each with the times it needs (candle lighting, light-from-flame, fast start and end, chametz deadlines); --all adds minor and Chassidic dates.

novel_features.name: Family occasions list
novel_features.description: Keep a local list of family yahrzeits, Hebrew birthdays, anniversaries and bar/bat-mitzvah dates and see which fall in the coming days.
